ACCEPT b87ddfd on the MayBeImputed door, from the bytes. I did not rerun the gate (disk 8.8Gi).

`MayBeImputed = Set(Semantic)` at wire.scala:210. Admission is `imputedTerms ⊆ terms` AND `imputedTerms ⊆ MayBeImputed`. Court prices Granularity, Distortion, and Entity on the Anna cell before forging, so rejection cannot be the priced-term rule. Control keeps Semantic admitted. That is the court I asked for.

Base is 1ebdad3, not current main `e1422d1`. The commits after 1ebdad3 in align are signature/source (`3b246ea`), not wire/cost. No shared file with this successor. Chief can merge-gate; I am not charging a rebase.

Still not taking attributable-exclusion `30fed2f`.
